parts.text: This question is about sulfur and compounds of sulfur.

ms.label: 5(a)
ms.text:
1 mark each for any 3 of:
•
does not conduct electricity / poor conductor of electricity / insulator
•
does not conduct heat / poor conductor of heat
•
brittle / not malleable / not ductile
•
not sonorous / dull sound when hit
•
not lustrous / not shiny
•
has (relatively) low melting point / low boiling point

ms.label: 5(b)
ms.text: in underground deposits / sulfide ores / volcanoes

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) When carbon is heated with sulfur, carbon disulfide, CS 2 , is produced. C + 2S → CS 2

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Complete the energy level diagram for the production of carbon disulfide by writing these formulae on the diagram: ● C + 2S ● CS 2 . [1]

ms.label: 5(c)(i)
ms.text: C + (2)S on lower line to left AND CS2 on upper line to right (1)

ms.label: 5(c)(ii)
ms.text: the product energy level is above the reactant energy level

ms.label: 5(d)
ms.text:
separation: particles close together / small spaces between the particles (1)
motion: limited (movement) / restricted (movement) / sliding over each other / random (motion) (1)

ms.label: 5(e)
ms.text:
1 mark each for any 3 of:
•
evaporation of hydrogen sulfide from the cotton wool / hydrogen sulfide molecules escape from solution
•
diffusion
•
molecules in (constant) movement / molecules collide / molecules travel
•
(movement of) molecules is random / in every direction
•
molecules spread out / molecules mix
•
molecules hit filter paper
•
(molecules spread) from higher concentration to lower concentration

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) Sulfur dioxide is a pollutant in the air.
